name: x2611_15358_pair_common_bound
statement: (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14)) (hdeg : ∀ v : Fin 14, 4 ≤ Nat.card (G.neighborSet v)) (hq : Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet ≤ 15) (S : Finset (Fin 14)) (hS : S.card = 2) : x2611_15358_t G S ≤ (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet) / 2 ∧ (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet) / 2 ≤ 15 / 2 ∧ (15 : ℕ) / 2 = 7
closed: ∀ (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14)) (hdeg : ∀ v : Fin 14, 4 ≤ Nat.card (G.neighborSet v)) (hq : Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet ≤ 15) (S : Finset (Fin 14)) (hS : S.card = 2), x2611_15358_t G S ≤ (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet) / 2 ∧ (Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet) / 2 ≤ 15 / 2 ∧ (15 : ℕ) / 2 = 7
informal: Lemma 2.6, proof (common neighbors of a pair)
original:
For an unordered pair $\{x,y\}$ , let $t_{xy}=|N_{G^{c}}(x)\cap N_{G^{c}}(y)|$ .
The $2t_{xy}$ edges joining the pair to its common neighbors in $G^{c}$ are distinct, so $t_{xy}\leq\lfloor q/2\rfloor\leq\lfloor 15/2\rfloor=7$ .
